name: Physical Imaging Model with Spherical Harmonics
definition: A module integrated into NeRF optimization that decomposes illumination into direct sunlight and ambient skylight (modeled by spherical harmonics), interacts with albedo and surface normals to synthesize physically constrained images for auxiliary supervision.
summary: This method integrates a physically constrained imaging model into NeRF optimization to decompose illumination using spherical harmonics, explicitly separating albedo and lighting to reduce ambiguity and improve reconstruction fidelity.
